title_sq: Apartament 1+1 ne shitje te Manhattan, Zogu i Zi!
description_sq:
Apartament 1+1 ne shitje ne nje nga projektet me moderne te Zogu i Zi, pjese e kompleksit rezidencial dhe multifunksional Manhattan, i cili po transformon kete zone ne nje nga qendrat me te rendesishme urbane ne Tirane.
Objekti eshte ndertuar sipas standardeve bashkekohore europiane, me arkitekture moderne, fasade cilesore dhe organizim funksional te hapesirave. Kompleksi ofron administrim profesional, siguri 24/7, ashensore moderne dhe ambiente te perbashketa të mirembajtura. Gjithashtu perfshin hapesira tregtare, sherbime dhe zona rekreative, duke krijuar nje stil jetese komod dhe praktik per banoret.
Apartamenti 1+1 eshte i mireorganizuar, duke ofruar ndriçim natyral, planimetri efikase dhe mundesi shfrytezimi maksimal te çdo metri katror.
Ideale si per banim ashtu edhe per investim, fale kerkeses se larte ne kete zone.
title_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in Manhattan, Black Bird!
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in one of the most modern projects in Zogu i Zi, part of the residential and multifunctional complex Manhattan, which is transforming this area into one of the most important urban centers in Tirana. The building was built according to contemporary European standards, with modern architecture, quality facades and functional organization of spaces. The complex offers professional management, 24/7 security, modern elevators and well-maintained common areas. It also includes commercial spaces, services and recreational areas, creating a comfortable and practical lifestyle for residents. The 1+1 apartment is well organized, offering natural lighting, efficient layout and maximum utilization of every square meter. Ideal for both residence and investment, thanks to the high demand in this area.
